name: Weathered Quiver
description: A dependable leather quiver. +3 base arrow damage.

name: Flint Arrowheads
description: Knapped points that bite deeper. +8% physical arrow damage.

name: Ranger’s Jerkin
description: Stitched for another close call. +20 maximum health and heal 20.

name: Iron Buckle
description: A sturdy fastening that turns glancing blows. +2 armor.

name: Trail Boots
description: Light soles for narrow escapes. +8% movement speed.

name: Gathering Compass
description: Pull nearby gold and XP toward you. +0.65m pickup radius.

name: Merchant’s Seal
description: Recognized by woodland traders. +10 Economy: save 10% on items and rerolls, up to 50%.

name: Salvage Satchel
description: Recover 75% of leftover ground gold at wave end, instead of 50%.

name: Prospector’s Purse
description: A lucky pouch for every haul. +15% gold earned.

name: Mending Moss
description: A soft woodland poultice that knits wounds once danger passes. After 5 seconds without taking damage, regenerate 1% maximum health per second.

name: Beeswax Bowstring
description: A smoother draw and faster release. +12% attack speed.

name: Fox Charm
description: A carved tribute to your companion. +25% fox dart damage; darts stay physical.

name: Etched Lodestone
description: A focus for any element. +4 shared elemental power.

name: Hawk’s Eye Lens
description: Find the weak seam. +8% critical chance; critical arrows deal 1.75× damage.

name: Bloodroot Brooch
description: A living root set in brass. Heal 1 health whenever an enemy dies.

name: Dewglass Flask
description: Slowly restores your strength during combat. +0.5 health per second.

name: Pocket Watch
description: Borrow a moment when it matters. −12% ability cooldowns; maximum 45% reduction.

name: Heartwood Relic
description: Once this run, survive a lethal hit and restore 35% maximum health. Cannot appear again once owned.

name: Ember Vial
description: Feed your flame. Fire burns deal 35% more damage.

name: Coalglass Lantern
description: Shelter the flame from the wind. Burns last 1 second longer.

name: Cinder Fletching
description: Charred feathers carry a hotter spark. +20% fire impact damage from elemental power.

name: Rime Shard
description: A winter edge. Ice slowing improves by 8 points against mobs, 4 against bosses.

name: Frostglass Bell
description: Its frozen note lingers. Ice slowing lasts 1 second longer.

name: Winter Arrowhead
description: A point cut from ancient ice. +25% ice impact damage from elemental power.

name: Venom Fang
description: Distilled venom coats each wound. Poison ticks deal 25% more damage.

name: Amethyst Flask
description: A deeper reserve of venom. +1 maximum poison stack, up to 7.

name: Nightshade Sprig
description: A potent woodland cutting. Poison lasts 1 second longer.
